description: This Java class 'Scheduler' manages task scheduling, execution, and shutdown for the MockServer project, including handling delays, synchronous/asynchronous execution, and logging.

classes.name: Scheduler
classes.description: Manages scheduling and execution of tasks, supporting delays, synchronous/asynchronous modes, and logging within the MockServer framework.

classes.name: Scheduler.SchedulerThreadFactory
classes.description: Custom thread factory for creating scheduler threads with specific naming and daemon settings.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the scheduler, waiting for ongoing tasks to complete.

methods.description: Executes a command with optional port setting, with error logging.
